Our Story

More Than a Café.
It's an Experience.

ThrusTea Café was born from a passion for bringing Aligarh's café culture to life — a place where stunning floral décor, artisan coffee, and carefully crafted food come together in perfect harmony.

From our signature handcrafted beverages to our indulgent pizzas and burgers — every detail is designed to make your visit unforgettable.
